hook.name: ZentralCoreFeeHook
hook.description: Volatility-based dynamic fee hook for the Zentral launchpad. Fees scale between a per-pool base and max rate (0.25%–3%) based on previous-swap tick movement, collected in ETH, token, or both per pool configuration. Input-side fees are taken in beforeSwap; output-side fees in afterSwap. Exact-output swaps are rejected; only exact-input swaps are supported.
